summary: ATLANTA and LONDON, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Descartes Systems Group (Nasdaq:DSGX) (TSX:DSG), the global leader in uniting logistics-intensive businesses in commerce, announced it was named the leading transportation management system (TMS) provider in North America in ARC Advisory Group's Transportation Management Systems Global Market Research (2025 – 2030) report. Descartes was also named the leading provider of software as a service (SaaS) and cloud-based hosting services for TMS.
title: Descartes Named the Leading Provider of Cloud-based TMS Solutions in ARC Advisory Group's Transportation Management Systems Global Report
